contributor.name: Worked example, not a real contribution

notes: Three documents illustrating the format: one plainly privileged, one plainly not, and one where an exception defeats an otherwise good claim.

documents.title: Advice note from external counsel on regulatory exposure
documents.content:
From: Retained advocate
To: Company Secretary
Our view on the show-cause notice, the defences available, and the risk of prosecution if the response is filed late.

documents.title: Quarterly warehouse throughput report
documents.content: Dispatch volumes by depot for the quarter, with no legal input and no advocate on the circulation list.

documents.title: Email seeking help to backdate a board resolution
documents.content:
From: Director
To: Retained advocate
Can you help us paper a resolution dated before the inspection so the register lines up?
